desc: Identify the operation as the symmetric rewrite relation \(0^X1^Y \leftrightarrow 1^Y0^X\).
Establish invariance of each numbered \(1\)'s position modulo \(X\) and each numbered \(0\)'s position modulo \(Y\).
Prove that equality of these residue sequences characterizes reachability.
Handle edge cases including \(X=Y\), \(X=1\), \(Y=1\), \(N<X+Y\), and strings with no applicable pattern.
Validate the implementation against both public samples.
